title: Voicemail picks up
why: Answering machines are shared with housemates, family and employers. The message may ask the person to call back; it must not disclose what coverage they have.
testerScript: Let it ring through to voicemail, or answer and stay completely silent. Do not speak at all.

assertions.label: names no programme and no rule to an unidentified listener
the word Medicaid is never left on a machine
recorded as not reached, so the person is redialled and then written to
